hypotheses.question: Does an arbitrary deterministic hash bucket of sessions predict positive 30m LONG return?
hypotheses.population: GOLD M1 decisions 08:00-12:30 COT in DEV
hypotheses.primary_metric: session-weighted difference in mean tradable return
hypotheses.null: Hash-assigned sessions and remaining sessions have equal mean 30m LONG return
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Reject as evidence if FDR-adjusted p > 0.05 or robustness gates fail
hypotheses.survival_criterion: Must pass all DEV evidence and skeptic gates

hypotheses.question: Is future 30m realized volatility higher during 08:00-08:30 COT than the session base rate?
hypotheses.population: GOLD M1 decisions 08:00-12:30 COT in DEV
hypotheses.primary_metric: paired session difference in mean realized volatility
hypotheses.null: Early-window and same-session remaining-window volatility are exchangeable at session level
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Reject if materiality, FDR or stability gates fail
hypotheses.survival_criterion: Positive material effect across temporal and parameter perturbations

hypotheses.question: Does high causal 15m volatility precede higher realized volatility over the next 30m?
hypotheses.population: GOLD M1 decisions 08:00-12:30 COT in DEV
hypotheses.primary_metric: paired session difference in mean realized volatility
hypotheses.null: Top-quartile causal volatility and lower-volatility observations have equal future volatility
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Reject if materiality, FDR or stability gates fail
hypotheses.survival_criterion: Positive material effect across years, regimes and neighbor quantiles

hypotheses.question: Does 08:30 COT show exceptional next-30m realized volatility relative to the full session base rate?
hypotheses.population: GOLD M1 decisions 08:00-12:30 COT in DEV
hypotheses.primary_metric: paired session difference in mean realized volatility
hypotheses.null: 08:30 and the same-session remaining minutes have equal future volatility
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: Reject if the exact minute is an isolated peak or robustness gates fail
hypotheses.survival_criterion: Material effect with stable neighboring minutes and temporal blocks
